commands.script:
python3 -c '
import fcntl,json,os,pty,re,select,signal,struct,subprocess,sys,termios,time
request=json.loads(sys.argv[1])
master,slave=pty.openpty()
fcntl.ioctl(slave,termios.TIOCSWINSZ,struct.pack("HHHH",32,120,0,0))
env=dict(os.environ,TERM="xterm-256color")
for key in ("ST_AGENT","ST3_INCARNATION","ST3_ENDPOINT"): env.pop(key,None)
proc=subprocess.Popen(request["argv"],stdin=slave,stdout=slave,stderr=slave,env=env,start_new_session=True)
os.close(slave)
raw=bytearray(); handled=[]; frame=False; navigated=False; quit_sent=False
deadline=time.monotonic()+request.get("timeout",45)
rules=[("Your name",b"ada\r"),("This machine'"'"'s name",b"studio\r"),
       ("Keep st running in the background",b"\r"),("The st daemon is not running. Start it?",b"\r"),
       ("Which harness",b"1\r")]
while time.monotonic()<deadline:
 if select.select([master],[],[],0.1)[0]:
  try: chunk=os.read(master,65536)
  except OSError: break
  raw.extend(chunk)
  if b"\x1b[c" in chunk: os.write(master,b"\x1b[?62;c")
  plain=re.sub(rb"\x1b\[[0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~]",b"",raw)
  compact=re.sub(rb"\s+",b"",plain)
  for text,answer in rules:
   if text not in handled and re.sub(rb"\s+",b"",text.encode()) in compact:
    os.write(master,answer); handled.append(text)
  # Never answer passwords or provider login requests.
  if b"\x1b[?1049h" in raw and b" working" in plain and not frame:
   frame=True; os.write(master,b"\x0b"); time.sleep(0.2); os.write(master,b"home"); time.sleep(0.2); os.write(master,b"\r")
   navigated=True; quit_at=time.monotonic()+1
  if frame and not quit_sent and time.monotonic()>=quit_at:
   os.write(master,b"\x11"); quit_sent=True
 if proc.poll() is not None: break
if proc.poll() is None:
 os.killpg(proc.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
 try: proc.wait(timeout=3)
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: os.killpg(proc.pid,signal.SIGKILL); proc.wait()
os.close(master)
plain=re.sub(rb"\x1b\[[0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~]",b"",raw).decode(errors="replace")
print(json.dumps({"argv":request["argv"],"exit":proc.returncode,"frame":frame,
 "home_navigation":navigated,"quit_sent":quit_sent,"answers":handled,
 "restored":b"\x1b[?1049l" in raw,"screen":plain}))
' '{"argv": ["/home/ada/.local/bin/st"], "timeout": 55}'
